_comment: Allowlisted data sources. scripts/prepare_data.py only downloads URLs listed here. sha256 values are the checksums observed on first download (2026-11-15); a mismatch fails preparation loudly.

sources.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX DTM Mosaic (MOLA topography, delta geoid), 20 m/pixel
sources.instrument: Context Camera (CTX), stereo-derived DTM controlled to MOLA
sources.producer: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (Mars 2020 TRN team)
sources.license: USGS/NASA product, public domain (U.S. Government work); credit USGS Astrogeology / NASA / JPL-Caltech / MSSS
sources.citation: Fergason, R.L., et al., 2020, Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation Flight Product Generation: Digital Terrain Model and Orthorectified Image Mosaic, 51st Lunar and Planetary Science Conference. Product page: https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/mars_2020_terrain_relative_navigation_ctx_dtm_mosaic

sources.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation CTX Orthorectified Image Mosaic, 6 m/pixel
sources.producer: USGS Astrogeology Science Center (Mars 2020 TRN team)
sources.units: 8-bit digital number (relative brightness, not calibrated reflectance)
sources.license: USGS/NASA product, public domain (U.S. Government work); credit USGS Astrogeology / NASA / JPL-Caltech / MSSS
sources.citation: Fergason et al. 2020 (as above). Product page: https://astrogeology.usgs.gov/search/map/mars_2020_terrain_relative_navigation_ctx_orthorectified_image_mosaic

sources.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region, Mars (USGS SIM 3464) - GIS database
sources.mission: Compiled from orbital data (CTX, HiRISE, CRISM, THEMIS and others)
sources.producer: USGS / JPL (Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M.)
sources.citation: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3464, pamphlet 14 p., 1 sheet, scale 1:75,000, https://doi.org/10.3133/sim3464
sources.known_limitation: USGS metadata: 'This map was created on a semi-controlled CTX mosaic prior to the release of the controlled CTX mosaic ... will have random offsets of about 100-200 meters from the surface operations CTX mosaic.'

sources.title: Mars 2020 Perseverance rover localized waypoints (MMGIS M20_waypoints.json)
sources.producer: NASA/JPL-Caltech Mars 2020 mission (public MMGIS map service)
sources.units: lon/lat degrees (Mars 2000 sphere, east-positive), elevation metres relative to geoid
sources.citation: NASA/JPL-Caltech, Mars 2020 'Where is the rover' waypoint service, accessed 2026-11-15
